@metadata.description: Embeddable content items (quotation, code snippet, mathematical expression) on a Wikibase instance — vocabulary manifests, maintenance scripts, embed rendering and content creation pages.

embeddablecontent-desc: Embeddable content items (quotation, code snippet, mathematical expression) on a Wikibase instance
embeddablecontent-error-notembeddable: This item is not an embeddable content item.
embeddablecontent-error-missingpayload: This item has no content payload.
embeddablecontent-add-entityid-help: Type an entity label to search and pick it, or enter an item id directly (e.g. Q5).
embeddablecontent-add-error-config: The embeddable-content configuration map is incomplete; run the seed.
embeddablecontent-add-error-anon: Anonymous users cannot create content items.
embeddablecontent-add-error-save: Saving failed; please check the input and try again.
embeddablecontent-entityid-multiple-hint: Type a label to search and pick items, or enter item ids directly. Several values are allowed — separate them with a comma (e.g. Q5, Q179).
embeddablecontent-source-title: Search for $1 … from an external authority
embeddablecontent-fictionalcharacter-sel: Select the fictional character to add
embeddablecontent-fictionalcharacter-rev: Review the fictional character to add
embeddablecontent-fictionalcharacter-fie: Type a label to search and pick the work(s) this character appears in, or enter item ids directly (e.g. Q42). Several values are allowed — separate them with a comma.
embeddablecontent-content-review-legend: Confirm, correct or remove the fetched content — only what you keep is written to the page.
embeddablecontent-extsearch-author-help: Narrow the search by author. Free text: a name (e.g. Albert Einstein). Entity: Wikidata Q-ids, comma-separated (e.g. Q42, Q179).
embeddablecontent-extsearch-error: Search failed: $1. Please try again or create the item manually.
embeddablecontent-extsearch-nohits: No matching records found. Try a different identifier or name, or create the item manually.
embeddablecontent-extsearch-loginrequire: Please log in to search external authorities or create items.
embeddablecontent-extselect-classrequire: Choose a class for the new item.
embeddablecontent-extcreate-error: Creating the item failed ($1: $2). Please try again or create it manually.
embeddablecontent-software-field-harvest: External record: $1 — create the item first if it does not exist yet (e.g. via Special:AddCollective).
embeddablecontent-software-userinterface: How the software interacts with the user — e.g. command line, graphical (GUI), web. Pick the matching item(s); several are allowed, separate them with a comma.
embeddablecontent-software-logo-error: Logo upload failed: $1. The software was created without a logo.
embeddablecontent-source-field-journal-h: Pick the journal entity (search by label), or enter an item id directly (e.g. Q42).
embeddablecontent-source-field-journal-u: External record: $1 — pick an existing item, or create it first if it does not exist yet (e.g. via Special:AddCollective).
embeddablecontent-person-portrait-licens: The license of the portrait image — required when a portrait is provided.
A portrait license is required when a portrait is provided.
embeddablecontent-add-error-badlanguage: Invalid language code for the quotation text.
embeddablecontent-add-error-badlexer: Unknown programming language "$1". Pick one from the list, or leave the field empty.
embeddablecontent-source-pick-legend: What source type are you adding?
embeddablecontent-extsearch-youtube-help: Paste a YouTube URL for an exact match, or type a name to search (top 10 matches shown).
embeddablecontent-extsearch-youtube-urln: No match for the provided URL.
embeddablecontent-source-field-authors-h: Type a label to search and pick people, organizations or groups, or enter item ids directly (e.g. Q5). Several values are allowed — separate them with a comma. A source needs at least one author.
embeddablecontent-source-parent-help: Pick the $1 this item is part of. $1 not yet imported to RonzzWikiBase? [[Special:AddSource/$2|import it yourself]].
embeddablecontent-source-url-help: The title, description and summary are fetched automatically when the site allows it — you can correct everything on the next pages.
embeddablecontent-source-url-error: Enter a valid public web address (http:// or https://).
embeddablecontent-source-website-explana: This page adds an entire '''website''' as a source. To cite a specific page of a website, first add the website here, then add the page as a child item: [[Special:AddSource/webpage/manual|add a web page]].
embeddablecontent-source-bookexcerpt-des: Will be auto-generated as ''Pages a-b (Volume c) of {book}'' from the pages/volume fields if left blank.
embeddablecontent-source-bookexcerpt-sam: Leave blank if the same as the parent $1.
embeddablecontent-source-error-duration: Invalid duration. Use MM:SS or HH:MM:SS (e.g. 3:45, 1:02:30).
embeddablecontent-source-error-noauthor: A source needs at least one author. Pick an existing person, organization or group, or create it first via Special:AddPerson.
embeddablecontent-source-error-author-en: The author item $1 does not exist. Pick an existing entity, or create it first via Special:AddPerson.
embeddablecontent-source-error-author-cl: The author item $1 is not a person, organization or group.
embeddablecontent-source-error-parent-re: Select the parent item this source is part of.
embeddablecontent-source-error-parent-cl: The parent item $1 is not of the required parent class.
embeddablecontent-sitelink-tab-set: This page is linked to item $1
embeddablecontent-sitelink-tab-unset: This page is not linked to an item — click to link it
embeddablecontent-sitelink-dialog-title: Link this page to an item
embeddablecontent-sitelink-placeholder: Search an item by label, or type a Q-id (e.g. Q42)
embeddablecontent-sitelink-badid: Enter a valid item id (e.g. Q42) or pick a search result.
embeddablecontent-source-field-access-do: The file is fetched and saved on this wiki automatically.
embeddablecontent-source-field-access-mo: How this source can be accessed.
embeddablecontent-source-field-license-h: You should not upload copyrighted content unless you have the right to distribute it publicly.
embeddablecontent-source-field-publisher: Pick the publisher entity (search by label), or enter an item id directly (e.g. Q42).
External record: $1 — pick an existing item, or create it first if it does not exist yet (e.g. via Special:AddCollective).
embeddablecontent-source-error-access-up: The file could not be uploaded: $1
embeddablecontent-source-error-license: A license is required when uploading a file.
